name: fabric-agent-adapter
description: Create Fabric-compatible agents, run them as always-alive local services with dashboards, and adapt existing projects to the versioned Fabric Agent Contract.

plugins.name: fabric-agent-adapter
plugins.description: Inspects an existing agent, API, MCP server, A2A peer, or terminal CLI; selects one Fabric profile per capability; scaffolds a contract-pinned provider bundle; and separates declaration, protocol, semantic, and binding-readiness verdicts; builds long-lived local agent services that follow fabric-service/0.1 with reference kits and a live conformance probe.
